name: agent-kevin
description: Portable, file-based personal AI assistant. Compiles raw sessions into a queryable wiki, manages tasks across project lifecycles, drives SEO/web tools (GSC, PageSpeed, SerpAPI, headless browser, web search), and ships 20+ skills covering onboarding, daily/weekly/monthly cadences, audits, and content workflows. All data stays as local markdown + YAML.

interface.longDescription: Kevin keeps a local markdown brain: identity files, a compiled wiki, active memory, and a task system. Every session is captured and compiled back into that brain, so the next session, in Codex or Claude Code, picks up where the last one left off.
defaultPrompt: Who are you and what's on my task list?
